hero.title: Hi, I'm Ángel Dorado
hero.desc: I combine end-to-end product design with design system leadership to turn complex problems into clear experiences, focused on what matters: users, business, and product.
about.label: ABOUT ME
about.title: Product designer with a strategic mindset
about.p1: Product Designer with over 10 years of experience in B2B and B2C environments, working on digital products of varying scale and complexity. I have led complex interface redesigns, user flow definition, user research, and product strategy, supporting the full process from initial definition through implementation.
about.p2: I currently work at Serviceware SE, where I combine end-to-end product design with leadership of the corporate Design System Code Blue, built from scratch and adopted by more than 12 products in the ecosystem. I am especially motivated by working at the intersection of design, product, and technology, collaborating closely with development and business teams to build solutions that deliver real value to users.
